resourceName: Restoration of burned-out forests through the carbon-sequestration plantation in forest-steppe zone
description:
The Project seeks to develop an Afforestation, Reforestation and Revegetation (hereinafter referred to as ARR) VCS project in Russian Federation, the Voronezh Oblast, the Levoberezhnoye Prigorodnoye Forestry district.

The project aims to create carbon-sequestration plantations (hereinafter referred to as CSPs)  on deforested areas to increase carbon stocks of woody biomass. Project activities are implemented in areas previously exposed by fires, which led to the formation of burned-out forests with low rates of natural regeneration.

The project allows to increase the carbon dioxide removal (hereinafter referred to as CO2 removal) by carrying out revegetation activities, including the cultivation of planting material in the form of various tree crops and the carrying of agrotechnical measures for their planting in deforested areas. The activity of creating CSPs in the burned-out forests contributes to an increase in the absorption of CO2 from the atmosphere during photosynthesis and carbon sequestration in carbon pools.
